title: Your Privacy Choices – CUEBOTS
bodyHtml:
Your Privacy Choices

As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.

Sharing of personal information for targeted advertising based on your interaction on different websites may be considered "sales", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.

If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are, we will treat this as a request to opt-out of activity that may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information or other uses that may be considered targeted advertising for the device and browser you used to visit our website.

title: ABOUT CUEBOTS
bodyHtml:
ABOUT CUEBOTS

Cuebots is a pioneering platform specializing in next-generation billiard cues made entirely from premium carbon fiber, integrated with proprietary core technology to deliver exceptional performance, maximum durability, and absolute stability under all conditions.

Guided by the philosophy “Made by players. For players.”, Cuebots places the player experience at the heart of every innovation. Every cue is meticulously engineered to deliver the ultimate sense of control, precision, and confidence — from aspiring beginners to elite professionals.

Beyond crafting cues, Cuebots defines a new standard in modern billiards — the perfect harmony of advanced materials, refined design, and timeless value.

Vision

To become a global technology-driven platform for billiard cues and accessories — where players can explore, customize, and express their individuality through products that embody innovation and contemporary design.
Cuebots aspires to redefine the modern standard of cue craftsmanship, blending emotion, performance, and technology to create an experience that transcends traditional limits.

Mission

  • To apply advanced materials and engineering to deliver cues that are ultra-durable, precise, and performance-driven for every player.
  • To build a global community of players and creators, connected by a shared passion for the game.
  • To inspire players to discover their unique style and embrace the power of individuality in every shot.

Core Values

  1. Player-Centered Design – Every innovation begins with the player’s experience in mind.
  2. Precision & Performance – Each detail is engineered for perfect balance, feedback, and accuracy.
  3. Technology Leadership – Continuous advancement in materials, structure, and process for superior results.
  4. Creative Spirit – Celebrating individuality and empowering players to express their unique identity.
  5. Global Connection – Building a collaborative ecosystem uniting players, designers, and brands through shared passion.

title: REFUND, EXCHANGE & CANCELLATION POLICY – CUEBOTS
bodyHtml:
REFUND, EXCHANGE & CANCELLATION POLICY

REFUND, EXCHANGE & CANCELLATION POLICY

If you experience any issues with your order, please contact us immediately at cs@cuebots.com. We are always happy to assist.

RETURNS & REFUNDS

30-Day Return Policy (Eligible Items Only)

Eligible items may be returned within 30 days of delivery if:

  • The item is new, unused, unchalked, and in original condition
  • All original packaging and accessories are included
  • Proof of purchase is provided

Approved refunds are processed within 14 business days after inspection.

Please note:

  • Shipping fees are non-refundable
  • A 10% restocking fee applies to all approved returns

CUEBOTS reserves the right to refuse returns in cases of abuse or repeated claims.

❗ Non-Refundable Items (Important)

The following items are FINAL SALE and not eligible for return, refund, exchange, or cancellation, unless there is a confirmed manufacturing defect:

  • Cue butts
  • Made-to-order products
  • Customized or personalized items
  • Limited edition or discontinued products
  • Accessories

Cue butts and made-to-order products are manufactured specifically upon order and are not pre-stocked. Once production begins or the item is shipped, the order cannot be canceled or refunded.

By placing an order for these products, you agree to this policy.

Used Items

Used or chalked items are not eligible for refunds.

If approved at our discretion, compensation will be issued as a store credit (90% of item value).

Sale & Promotional Items

All items purchased during sales, special promotions, discounts over 10%, Buy-One-Get-One offers are non-refundable.

If Free Shipping promotion was applied, the actual shipping cost incurred by CUEBOTS will be deducted from any approved refund.

EXCHANGES

Eligible items may be exchanged within 30 days of delivery for another product of equal or higher value.

  • Customers are responsible for return shipping and insurance
  • Each order is eligible for one exchange only
  • Restocking fees may apply depending on item condition

Cue butts, made-to-order items, accessories, and final-sale products are not eligible for exchange.

DEFECTIVE ITEMS & WARRANTY

Defective items must be reported within 30 days of delivery.

If confirmed, we will offer:

  • A replacement, or
  • A store credit equal to the purchase value

All products are covered under the CUEBOTS Limited Lifetime Warranty.

ORDER CANCELLATION

Orders may be canceled within 24 hours of purchase, provided they have not been processed or shipped.

Approved cancellations are subject to a 10% processing fee.

Non-Cancellable Orders

The following orders cannot be canceled:

  • Cue butts
  • Made-to-order products
  • Customized items
  • Accessories
  • Sale or promotional orders

title: Shipping Policy – CUEBOTS
bodyHtml:
Shipping Policy

Shipping & Delivery

At Cuebots, we strive to provide a seamless and efficient shopping experience, ensuring your orders arrive on time and in perfect condition. Please take a moment to review our shipping policy:

1. Order Processing Time

  • Processing Time:
    Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days from the time they are placed. Orders submitted on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next business day.
  • Customized Products:
    All customized items are made to order and shipped directly from our facility in Vietnam. Please allow approximately 15–20 days for production and processing before shipment.
  • Split Shipments:
    In some cases, your order may be divided into multiple shipments. These may be dispatched from different locations, and you will receive separate tracking details for each shipment.
  • Partial Shipments:
    If certain items in your order are temporarily out of stock, we may ship the available items first. The remaining items will be shipped as soon as they become available.
  • Tracking Information:
    Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a notification email with full tracking details.

2. Shipping Methods and Delivery Time

  • We offer various shipping options depending on your location and the items in your order.
  • Standard shipping usually takes between 5-7 business days within the United States. However, if your order is shipped out from our facility in Vietnam, it would take around 15 days for the shipment to arrive at its destination.

3. Shipping Rates

  • Shipping costs are calculated based on the size, weight, and destination of your order.
  • Unless stated otherwise, shipping costs are always customers’ responsibility and non-refundable under any circumstances.

4. Tracking Order

  • Once your order has shipped, you will receive an email with a tracking number and a link to track your shipment.
  • If you experience any issues with tracking or delivery, please contact our customer service team for assistance.

5. Shipping Delays

  • While we aim to ensure timely deliveries, Cuebots is not responsible for delays caused by the carrier and external factors including weather, holidays, or other unforeseen circumstances.
  • Please check with the carrier for the latest updates on your shipment.

6. Damaged or Lost Items

  • In the unlikely event that an item arrives damaged, please contact us within 24 hours of receiving your order. We recommend including a photo of the package and a brief description of the damage for quicker resolution.
  • If there is any damage or loss once the package is in transit, we will assist with the claims process through the carrier. Please note that we may need to wait up to 30 days since the claim date to replace the product, as it could be located and delivered within that time frame.
  • Cuebots is not liable for theft issues after delivery. In the case of theft, we strongly advise customers to file a claim with the carrier or contact local authorities.

7. Return and Exchanges

Please refer to our Return & Exchange Policy for more information about how to return or exchange any item once they’ve been delivered.

8. Address Changes

  • If you need to modify the shipping address or details after placing an order, please contact us immediately.
  • Once an order has been shipped, we cannot modify the delivery address. In such cases, the customer will be responsible for any additional shipping fees.

9. Contact Us

  • If you have any questions or concerns about shipping, please reach out to our customer service team at cs@cuebots.com

Thank you for shopping with Cuebots! We appreciate your support and are here to help with any shipping-related questions you may have.

title: LIMITED LIFETIME WARRANTY – CUEBOTS
bodyHtml:
LIMITED LIFETIME WARRANTY

With a commitment to 100% customer satisfaction, Cuebots is dedicated to delivering value beyond expectations through superior products and services. Our limited lifetime warranty policy applies to all cues and shafts, serving as clear proof of timeless quality and our dedication to the long-term benefit of our customers.

This policy is not only a strong commitment to the durability and performance of our products but also a reflection of our responsibility in accompanying and wholeheartedly supporting our customers throughout their ownership journey. To Cuebots, your peace of mind is always our top priority.

Warranty Coverage

All Cuebots cues and shafts are covered by a lifetime warranty against material and workmanship defects under normal usage conditions.

This program is valid for the direct original purchaser only and is non-transferable. 

The lifetime warranty covers the following technical defects:

  • Cracks, breaks, or fractures on the butt or shaft surface
  • Shaft or cue showing signs of warping
  • Unusual hitting sound caused by internal structural defects
  • Broken, loose, or worn-out joints that affect performance
  • Paint peeling or cracking not caused by user impact

The following cases are not covered by the warranty:

  • Failure to provide proof of purchase history
  • Products that have been modified or customized in structure, design, or appearance
  • Warping caused by strong impact, improper usage, or visible scratches/dents on the shaft or butt
  • Products repaired or altered by unauthorized third parties, including but not limited to: worn-out ferrules from improper tip replacement, reduced durability or structural integrity, visible scratches/dents on shaft or butt, or bent joints due to incorrect assembly
  • Minor paint scratches from normal usage
  • Accessories category
  • Consumable items such as tips, grip wraps, rubber bumpers, and joint protectors

Warranty Process

  • Contact Cuebtots via email cuebotspayments@gmail.com
  • Provide images or send the actual product for evaluation.
  • Cuebots will repair or replace the product free of charge, depending on the damage level.
  • Shipping and insurance costs (if applicable) are covered by the customer.

Processing time:

  • Standard: within 3 - 7 working days after eligibility is confirmed.
  • For irreparable cases, a 100% product replacement is guaranteed.

 Additional Services Beyond Warranty

  • Repairs outside of warranty are available for a fee, offered at discounted rates.
  • Upgrades and official accessories offered at preferential pricing for returning customers.

We reserve the right to decline warranty service and suspend future services in cases of abuse or misuse of this policy.
